verdict.rationale: Aleph is a SaaS FP&A platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path, and no doc mentions a public API spec. The llms.txt file is a product summary, not an API spec, and the '150+ connectors, plus anything with an API' line describes inbound integrations, not Aleph's own API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
